items.html: And also the reason, for you know that Chochma-Bina and Chesed, each includes seventy-two, and the Gevurot include all of them, which are two hundred and sixteen, as mentioned above regarding the secret of "and He passed, seventy-two, two hundred and sixteen." And the reason is that the Gevurot are needed for Malchut, the final Hei of the Name, and it must include within it all the phases of the three letters Yud-Hei-Vav that are above it, which are Chochma, Bina, and Chesed, each of which comprises seventy-two, and it is the totality of three times seventy-two, becoming two hundred and sixteen.
